messages:
sam: heads-up: got a support ticket where a client reconnect + truncated toolcall produced a weird ledger sequence: customer saw double confirmed tokens then a negative adjust. attaching minimal logs.
noor: paste logs pls, curious if this is replay vs retry ordering.
sam: logs:
```
2026-03-12T14:01:10.001Z [proxy] session=sessX event=resume provisional=120 tx=tx-main
2026-03-12T14:01:10.050Z [tool-worker] session=sessX call=kb_lookup provisional=80 tx=tx-tool-A
2026-03-12T14:01:10.100Z client=EOF -> connection resets, client reconnects
2026-03-12T14:01:10.180Z [tool-worker] session=sessX call=kb_lookup provisional=30 tx=tx-tool-B (retry)
2026-03-12T14:01:10.300Z [ledger] confirm tx=tx-main tokens=120
2026-03-12T14:01:10.320Z [ledger] confirm tx=tx-tool-B tokens=30
2026-03-12T14:01:10.325Z [ledger] adjust tx=tx-tool-A tokens=-80 // reconciler replaced A with B
``` 
sam: net effect on UI: +120, +30, then -80 (out of order), support saw a transient -50 and were alarmed.
chip: reconciler emitting raw negative adjust without clear reconciliation metadata is the problem. UI renders events in timestamp order which can make transient negatives look like data loss.
anya: agreed. quick fixes:
- reconciler should emit one reconciled_confirm event (canonical_tx, replaced=[...], net_tokens) instead of separate negative adjust + confirm
- tool-worker should include retry_of=<tx-tool-A> when issuing B so lineage exists
- buffer reconciler emissions for ~150-200ms to wait for quick retries so UI doesn't show the interim negative
billing-bot: billing-alert created: unusual-reconcile session=sessX delta=-80
noor: buffering only in UI layer? ledger state must still be correct. We can buffer the publish of human-readable events, keep raw ledger writes as-is.
chip: agreed. also add reconciler metadata to ledger writes: canonical_tx and replaced_tx_list. that helps downstream consumers (analytics, console) render atomically.
anya: console UX: add a collapsed timeline item for "reconciliation" that expands to show original provisional entries and the reconciled result. add a tooltip: "This entry reconciles retries for the same logical toolcall."
sam: telemetry: add metric reconciliation.events.count and reconciliation.negative_delta.rate and alert if negative_delta spikes above baseline.
noor: long-term: encourage tool-worker to attach request-level client-request-id so rerouted/retried attempts can be grouped deterministically in ledger.
ops-bot: created ticket BILL-1214 reconciler-event-metadata; flagged oncall.
sam: I'll open an RFC with repro, reconciler event schema, and small console patch. plan canary in staging: apply reconciler metadata + UI buffering only. owners: sam (RFC), chip (reconciler), anya (console). Thanks all."
